role: Principal production AI systems engineer, SRE, embedded Linux engineer, Jetson engineer, safety engineer, and empirical ML evaluation researcher
objective: Turn jetson-xavier-rlr into a genuinely unattended, reboot-resilient, fail-safe, 24/7 autonomous RLR governor. Research first, inspect the real implementation and hardware, implement missing production hardening, deploy safely, fault-inject, benchmark end-to-end, and only enable autonomous 24/7 mode if every preregistered production gate passes.
non_negotiable: Do not claim production readiness from architecture, unit tests, smoke tests, or intuition.
Do not fabricate evidence, metrics, hardware capabilities, fan tach support, watchdog support, or benchmark results.
Use the current repo, machine, Jetson, services, logs, systemd configuration, benchmark artifacts, and actual hardware capabilities as ground truth.
Prefer primary documentation and source code over blogs.
Record exact commands, commits, hashes, configurations, test results, temperatures, failures, retries, and deviations.
Never weaken an existing safety threshold merely to make a test pass.
Do not disable NVIDIA/kernel thermal protection.
Do not raise power mode above the current safe production target merely to improve benchmark results.
The LLM/RLR process must never be authorized to modify its own hard safety policy, watchdog, thermal limits, privilege boundary, allow-list, rollback controller, or 24h enable gate.
If a production gate fails, keep 24/7 autonomous mode disabled and fix the root cause.

important_prior_failure.implication: Long-running autonomous inference is not yet proven safe.

accelerated_phase_b.interpretation: Engineering is promising, but RLR action-quality lift over simple baselines has not been demonstrated.

instructions: Identify the exact Jetson Linux/L4T/JetPack release actually installed before choosing documentation.

Research NVIDIA primary documentation matching Xavier NX, especially platform power/performance, thermal zones, cooling, throttling, nvpmodel, tegrastats, fan/tach interfaces, BPMP protections, and hardware thermal shutdown.
Research Linux kernel watchdog documentation and inspect the actual watchdog devices and drivers on this Jetson.
Research the installed systemd version's service watchdog, restart, start-rate-limit, dependency, resource-control, hardening, and hardware watchdog capabilities.
Research SQLite official documentation for WAL, synchronous durability, checkpointing, integrity_check, foreign_key_check, online backup/recovery, and corruption handling.
Inspect current llama.cpp server behavior, health endpoints, shutdown behavior, timeout characteristics, process ownership, context limits, and exit codes from the installed build/source.
Inspect the repository's current governor, thermal guard, policy, safety, runtime, forecast, store, benchmark harness, deployment scripts, and systemd/container integration.
For every important design decision, save source title, source type, retrieval date, applicable software/hardware version, and the concrete conclusion derived from it.
Reject a source when it applies to Orin but not Xavier unless the mechanism is independently verified on the actual Xavier system.
source_priority: other sources only as secondary context

principles: One supervisor owns each inference process.
Every autonomous action is bounded and validated.
Safety layer is outside the model-controlled trust boundary.
Repeated recovery failure terminates in SAFE_STOP rather than infinite retry.
A reboot must reconstruct trustworthy state before autonomy resumes.

A_behavioral_evidence.goal: Prove or disprove that full RLR B2 provides useful decision-quality lift.
tasks: Build a genuinely held-out benchmark with at least 100 cases unless evidence supports a larger minimum.
Do not let the candidate generate its own answer key.
Seal ground truth before inference.
Cover internal, external, hybrid, ambiguous, malformed, adversarial, thermal, resource-pressure, recovery, and abstention cases.
Balance required-action classes so set_load_target cannot dominate the benchmark.
Keep B0, B0F, B1, B2, B2n, NO_SELF_MODEL, and DEV-only MAJORITY.
Use matched cases and fixed seeds.
Randomize/interleave condition ordering where possible.
Use unchanged deterministic scoring.
Report invalid outputs separately; never silently drop them.
Fix all null knowing_action_set paths.
Use paired bootstrap confidence intervals.
Pre-register metrics and pass criteria before candidate inference.

gate.rule: Every preregistered primary comparison must have positive mean paired lift and 95% CI lower bound > 0 on the primary metric. Do not optimize the benchmark after results are observed.
gate.note: If B2 still provides no meaningful lift, production autonomy may continue only if the product requirement explicitly does not depend on RLR intelligence improvement; otherwise stop and fix the RLR behavior before proceeding.

tasks: Create self-state tests where the answer is not repeated verbatim in the current prompt or reflection anchor.
Test delayed state recall across process restarts and session boundaries.
Test stale-state rejection.
Test contradictory telemetry.
Test missing telemetry.
Test false-memory resistance.
Test forecast causality: prediction must be persisted before target observation.
Compare model forecast against persistence and linear baselines on substantially more than 3 windows.
Prevent future observation leakage.
Do not claim forecasting value unless it beats simple baselines on held-out data.
Implement or harden an explicit supervisor state machine.
Ensure only the supervisor can spawn and terminate llama-server.
Use process groups/cgroups so child cleanup is deterministic.
Kill stale/orphan inference processes before restart.
Add startup readiness probe.
Add liveness heartbeat.
Add per-request inference timeout.
Add graceful shutdown deadline followed by SIGKILL if needed.
Add bounded exponential restart/backoff.
Add restart counters persisted across service restarts when appropriate.
Escalate to SAFE_STOP after repeated failures.
Never automatically loop forever on an unrecoverable fault.
Inspect whether /dev/watchdog or /dev/watchdog0 exists and identify its actual driver.
Verify watchdog behavior experimentally in a controlled manner before enabling it for production.
Use systemd service watchdog notification if supported by the implementation.
Configure Restart behavior deliberately rather than using unlimited blind restart.
Configure restart-rate limits.
If hardware watchdog support is real and safely testable, configure systemd RuntimeWatchdogSec or equivalent appropriate to the installed version.
Verify that a deliberately hung supervisor stops refreshing its watchdog and produces the intended recovery.
Verify reboot recovery.
Never assume watchdog support from documentation alone.
Keep existing NVIDIA/kernel/BPMP thermal protections untouched.
Keep current 10W target unless evidence and explicit approval justify otherwise.
Enumerate every thermal zone actually available.
Determine the correct production control sensor or conservative maximum across zones.
Determine whether real fan RPM/tach telemetry exists on this Xavier carrier/module.
If tach exists, monitor it and define fan-stall behavior.
If tach does not exist, document that fact and implement alternative cooling-failure detection using supported observables.
Track current, rolling max, rate of rise, throttle state, and thermal events.
Stop inference before hardware protection becomes the normal control mechanism.
Preserve the existing conservative 72C emergency abort unless stronger evidence supports an even safer threshold.
Require cooldown hysteresis before restarting inference.
Verify thermal-guard independence from the RLR process.
fault_tests: cooling degradation simulation where safely possible

tasks: Inventory every action the RLR can request.
Define a static hard allow-list outside model control.
Schema-validate every action.
Range-check every parameter.
Rate-limit state-changing actions.
Add idempotency keys where relevant.
Separate proposed, validated, vetoed, and executed actions.
Persist E_proposed, E_invalid, E_vetoed, and E_act separately.
Never execute arbitrary shell generated by the model.
Do not give the model root access.
Prevent model-controlled modification of systemd units, safety policy, nvpmodel, thermal trips, watchdog settings, deployment controller, SSH configuration, or allow24 gate.
Abstain or SAFE_STOP on unknown action types.
Audit SQLite schema and migration correctness.
Verify WAL is really active if selected.
Choose synchronous mode based on explicit durability requirements and document the tradeoff.
Add periodic WAL checkpoint policy if operationally needed.
Run PRAGMA quick_check routinely and full integrity_check at safe maintenance points.
Run foreign_key_check where foreign keys exist.
Implement consistent online backup/snapshot.
Restore a backup into a disposable DB and integrity-check the restored copy.
Record boot_id/session_id so monotonic timestamps are never compared across boots incorrectly.
Make migrations transactional/idempotent.
Simulate process death during writes.
Simulate abrupt host reboot/power-loss-like termination as safely as possible.
Test WAL/shm recovery.
Test corrupt-copy detection without intentionally damaging the sole production DB.
Use structured logs.
Include boot_id, run_id, candidate commit and model hash.
Ensure logs survive service restart.
Rotate logs with bounded disk usage.
Add a concise health endpoint or CLI returning HEALTHY, DEGRADED, or SAFE_STOP and reasons.
Maintain candidate and last-known-good artifacts separately.
Hash code, config, model and policy artifacts.
Promote atomically.
Do not modify the only known-good build in place.
On post-deployment gate failure, automatically roll back.
Test rollback by intentionally deploying a controlled broken candidate.
Verify rollback survives reboot.

requirements: Hard safety layer starts before autonomous inference.
Governor does not resume unsafe work until prerequisites pass.
Previous interrupted action is never blindly replayed unless explicitly idempotent.

fault_injection_matrix: fill disk to warning threshold in a safe test filesystem
use a deliberately corrupted copy of the state DB

test_policy.unit: Run complete relevant suite after every structural change.
test_policy.integration: Run process, DB, systemd, supervisor, watchdog, policy, thermal and rollback tests.
test_policy.e2e: Run real model on real Xavier under the actual supervisor and safety stack.
test_policy.fault_injection: Every listed failure must produce an explicitly expected state transition.

soak_ladder.rule: Do not compress these durations. Their purpose is discovering time-dependent failures.
advance_only_if: temperature remains within preregistered operating envelope
no unresolved DEGRADED or SAFE_STOP event

must_all_pass: Research evidence is version-matched and saved.
Held-out action benchmark completed with sealed ground truth.
B2 primary behavioral gate passes, or an explicit documented product decision removes intelligence lift as a production requirement.
No invalid/null action path remains unhandled.
Every model-issued action is hard-policy validated.
Thermal guard operates independently of the model.
No thermal abort during required soak ladder.
No orphan llama-server after any fault test.
Watchdog behavior is verified on actual hardware/software.
allow_24h remains false until all prior gates pass.
final_enable_sequence: freeze candidate commit and all config hashes
restart governor through its normal production supervisor

implementation_rules: Add tests before or with each fix.
Do not silently change existing semantics.
Do not merge broken experiments into the production-safety branch.
Keep production branch deployable after each committed milestone.
Prefer deterministic logic for safety-critical code.
LLM output may propose behavior; deterministic software owns permission and enforcement.
execution: Inspect first; do not ask routine questions.
Research and cite evidence before changing safety-critical behavior.
Implement the highest-risk production blockers first.
Use the real Jetson for end-to-end verification.
Do not wait for approval between ordinary reversible engineering steps.
Do not enable 24/7 until the final gate is objectively green.
If a test fails, diagnose, fix, rerun, and preserve the failed evidence.
At completion, return concise JSON only: status, completed, failed, evidence, metrics, blockers, allow_24h, next.
